open_points.subject: reach_operation_element pre-send failure timestamps
open_points.text: - reach_operation_element: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] Never reads a Run record, never derives a run status and never decides which element comes next; every fact about the run arrives in the arguments. Every record MUST be written with record_change under the acting Actor; the change supplies no attempt_number, store position, minted identity or by-field. Every time MUST come from kernel_now: an operation NodeExecutionDraft's started_at is the recorded_at of its EffectAttempt when it has one, otherwise the moment the check or send began, and ended_at the moment the outcome change is built.
open_points.other_text: - reach_operation_element: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] A pre-send failure's NodeExecutionDraft has executed the ExecutedBinding of the binding, inputs the element's input PortRefs, no outputs, no resources_used, and started_at and ended_at the times of the check; it writes no EffectAttempt and leaves every approval of the element as it was.
open_points.question: Must a pre-send failure's ended_at be the time of the check or the later moment when the outcome change is built?

open_points.subject: send_under_authority input references
open_points.text: - send_under_authority: [ORCHESTRATION] For a binding whose effect_class is not read MUST first write RecordAttemptInFlightChange naming the element, the binding_id, the element's input PortRefs, the authority and the idempotency_key, and take the attempt_number store assigned; only then call send_prepared_request once with the request and the binding's effect_class; then build and write exactly one outcome change. For a read binding no EffectAttempt is written, no authority is recorded, and the attempt number used for spooling is the count of the element's NodeExecutions read with ExecutionsOfElement plus one.
open_points.other_text: - ElementRef fields (exact, no others exist): node_id: str, map_index: int | None
open_points.question: Where do the required element input PortRefs come from, since ElementRef has no such field and send_under_authority receives no inputs argument?

open_points.subject: send_under_authority execution inputs
open_points.text: - send_under_authority: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] The NodeExecutionDraft has status the SendResult outcome name (= models.NodeExecutionStatus), detail_code and failure_detail from the SendResult, executed the ExecutedBinding of the binding, inputs the element's input PortRefs, outputs one StoredValuesRef or SpooledFilesRef per output port in port name order, a SpooledFilesRef with the class the binding declares for that port, and no resources_used.
open_points.other_text: - ElementRef fields (exact, no others exist): node_id: str, map_index: int | None
open_points.question: Where do the NodeExecutionDraft inputs come from, since the element has no input PortRefs field?

open_points.subject: send_under_authority idempotency key
open_points.text: def send_under_authority(run: RunContext, element: ElementRef, binding: OperationBinding, request: PreparedRequest, authority: Authority | None, actor: Actor) -> ElementConclusion
open_points.other_text: - send_under_authority: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] The idempotency_key is absent when the binding's idempotency_key_fields is empty; otherwise it is content_identity of a KeyFieldsContent holding, as JsonPayloads, the canonical JSON of each named input port's value; the service receives those fields only as the inputs themselves.
open_points.question: How can send_under_authority obtain each named input port's canonical value when its signature receives neither the input PortRefs nor the input payloads?

open_points.subject: send_under_authority transformed successful outcome status and detail
open_points.text: - send_under_authority: [BEHAVIOR] When the SendResult outcome is succeeded MUST store the outputs before writing: each JSON output whose canonical bytes exceed the imported RELEASE_CEILING_STORED_VALUE_BYTES_MAX constant turns the outcome into contract_violation with detail value_too_large and no outputs; otherwise each JSON output is published with put_value_bytes and becomes a StoredValue of value carriage with the output port's stored schema (M21: its value_schema, or for a many port the canonical array schema with it as items), its size and the class the binding declares for that port, and a file output is published with spool_file under SpooledFileKey of the run, node, map_index, this attempt_number, the port and no list_index, becoming a SpooledFile of the port's declared class; a RefusedError from spool_file turns the outcome into contract_violation with no outputs, the attempt still applied.
open_points.other_text: - send_under_authority: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] The NodeExecutionDraft has status the SendResult outcome name (= models.NodeExecutionStatus), detail_code and failure_detail from the SendResult, executed the ExecutedBinding of the binding, inputs the element's input PortRefs, outputs one StoredValuesRef or SpooledFilesRef per output port in port name order, a SpooledFilesRef with the class the binding declares for that port, and no resources_used.
open_points.question: When output processing changes a succeeded SendResult into contract_violation, must the execution use that transformed status and value_too_large detail, or retain the original SendResult's succeeded status and detail fields?

open_points.subject: send_under_authority outputs after output-processing failure
open_points.text: - send_under_authority: [BEHAVIOR] When the SendResult outcome is succeeded MUST store the outputs before writing: each JSON output whose canonical bytes exceed the imported RELEASE_CEILING_STORED_VALUE_BYTES_MAX constant turns the outcome into contract_violation with detail value_too_large and no outputs; otherwise each JSON output is published with put_value_bytes and becomes a StoredValue of value carriage with the output port's stored schema (M21: its value_schema, or for a many port the canonical array schema with it as items), its size and the class the binding declares for that port, and a file output is published with spool_file under SpooledFileKey of the run, node, map_index, this attempt_number, the port and no list_index, becoming a SpooledFile of the port's declared class; a RefusedError from spool_file turns the outcome into contract_violation with no outputs, the attempt still applied.
open_points.other_text: - send_under_authority: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] The NodeExecutionDraft has status the SendResult outcome name (= models.NodeExecutionStatus), detail_code and failure_detail from the SendResult, executed the ExecutedBinding of the binding, inputs the element's input PortRefs, outputs one StoredValuesRef or SpooledFilesRef per output port in port name order, a SpooledFilesRef with the class the binding declares for that port, and no resources_used.
open_points.question: For value_too_large or a spool_file refusal, must execution outputs be empty or contain one output reference per output port?
